test_PackTag: test PackTag to encode a field number and wire type into a protobuf tag integer
test_UnpackTag: test UnpackTag to decode a protobuf tag integer back into field number and wire type
test_ZigZagEncode: test ZigZagEncode to transform signed integers for efficient varint encoding in protobuf wire format
test_ZigZagDecode: test ZigZagDecode to reverse a ZigZag encoded value back to its original signed integer
test_ByteSizeFunctions: test numeric ByteSize functions like Int32ByteSize and UInt64ByteSize to calculate serialized byte sizes
